fields: h, intro, cols (three labels), rows [[line, how, what]] (a cell may be {t, link}), lines (the role of each row in order: limit | action | alert | trend; default that order), tabs (screen tab names, the first one shown; decoration, aria-hidden). best_for: HmiTrend sets a table of alarm lines (line, how it is set, what the system does) as the operator panel's own screen: a dark instrument panel with a trend plot of one reading under the limit lines, flagged by the trend rule before it reaches any of them, and the alarm summary as the real table.
